text: Get fucked up, have sex, what else is there? There is as much in that little space within the heart as there is in the whole world outside. How do I look? Text me later. I can't read. Special times for special things. Special people. Where have we been? Hell is, hell is, hell is, hell is like this. Mistletoe.
